scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && echo 'git hooks → .githooks (openapi:check on commit)'
scripts.openapi:sync: cp docs/openapi-check-timing.yaml extension/shared/openapi-check-timing.yaml && cp docs/check-timing.schema.json extension/shared/check-timing.schema.json && cp docs/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md extension/shared/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md
scripts.openapi:check: cmp -s docs/openapi-check-timing.yaml extension/shared/openapi-check-timing.yaml && cmp -s docs/check-timing.schema.json extension/shared/check-timing.schema.json && cmp -s docs/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md extension/shared/API_CHECK_CONTRACT.md
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run smoke:desktop-scan-resources && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run threat:check && npm run build
scripts.threat:check: npm run threat:validate && npm run regression
scripts.threat:check:help: node -e "const lines=['threat:check exit: 0=ok, 1=invalid curated list or regression fail, 2=cannot read curated file','After PT list changes, npm run evaluate must keep EVAL-029–032 green (MERGE_PT on/off + benign lookalike).']; for (const m of lines) { console.log(m); if (process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS==='true') console.log('::notice::'+m); }"
